The psalm it sets
Watts made this hymn from Psalm 149, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

1Hallelujah! Sing to the LORD a new song— His praise in the assembly of the godly. 2Let Israel rejoice in their Maker; let the children of Zion rejoice in their King. 3Let them praise His name with dancing, and make music to Him with tambourine and harp. 4For the LORD takes pleasure in His people; He adorns the afflicted with salvation. … 5 more verses PSALM 149 · ITS FIRST VERSES · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PSALM 149
